title: Bounded FMC surface-infiltration and hiatus redistribution comparator
purpose: Test whether the literature-bound FMC atmospheric-side route retains more vertical redistribution fidelity than admitted R2 coarse Richards on a matched no-runoff, no-bottom-flow B01 pulse-to-hiatus envelope, before any general surface or application claim.

predecessor_authority.D12: FMC/SMVE constitutive/equation preflight passed with 200 bins and max 10 s process step.
predecessor_authority.D13: FMC groundwater-front branch beat matched R2 inside a bounded fixed-water-table envelope.
predecessor_authority.D14: Eq.18 surface-front and Eq.19 falling-slug kinematics passed.
predecessor_authority.D15: Full atmospheric-side finite-volume accounting passed; D16 exposed development comparator authorized.

state_and_geometry.initial_surface_connected_fronts: linear in j from z_101=120 cm to z_199=10 cm
state_and_geometry.initial_mapping_to_SWAP: For each R16/R2 cell, water content is the exact finite-volume average of baseline theta_i plus dtheta times the overlap of every connected [0,z_j] interval with the cell. Pressure head is the B01 inverse-retention value of that cell-average theta.

top.interpretation: prescribed infiltrating soil-water flux, not rainfall supply
top.native_SWAP_sign: downward physical q_in maps to forcing.top_flux=-q_in
top.preflight_requirement: FMC must absorb the entire prescribed supply at every pulse substep; any residual surface water/runoff makes that history fail closed because the matched prescribed-infiltration boundary would no longer be equivalent.

bottom.SWAP: bottom mode 2 with prescribed bottom flux 0 cm/day
bottom.FMC: no groundwater front and no bottom exchange
bottom.safety_requirement: every connected or falling-slug interval must remain strictly above 160 cm; otherwise fail closed

pulse_phase: compute D14 Eq.18 potential advance for every currently surface-connected bin using frozen B01 relations and current front depth
allocate exact prescribed infiltration supply left-to-right using D15 finite-volume accounting
partial final connected-front advance is allowed; dry-bin activation is not expected because all j=101..199 bins are already active in I_DEEP
apply D14/Ogden-2015 conservative capillary relaxation to connected-front ordering
FMC_dynamic_algorithm.hiatus_transition: At the first zero-supply step, every connected [0,z_j] interval detaches to one falling slug [0,z_j] with identical water volume.
hiatus_phase: translate each falling slug by D14 Eq.19 for exactly one 10 s step
top and bottom of each same-bin slug translate identically
no new connected surface front is created
no slug collision/merge is expected in this single-pulse design; any collision, overlap with bottom boundary, or physical-domain failure is fail closed
FMC_dynamic_algorithm.capillary_relaxation_during_hiatus: none beyond D14-qualified slug translation; D16 intentionally isolates the published falling-slug kinematic memory after detachment

SWAP_comparators.numerical_authority: D4 strict-first integrated-water-depth reattempt policy; hard accepted-transaction mass gate 1e-12 cm; no production tolerance change.

tests: for all four histories and all 16 pulse steps, prescribed supply is fully absorbed with residual <=1e-14 cm and no dry-bin activation/runoff
all 48 hiatus slug-translation steps remain inside 0..160 cm with no collision/merge
FMC global finite-volume ledger closes to <=1e-14 cm over each complete 64-step history
internal_preflight_before_SWAP_trajector.failure_rule: If any test fails, close D16 before generating R16/R2 trajectories; no factor/duration/bin/substep retuning is allowed.

diagnostics: R16/R2 nonlinear iterations and research reattempt counts
excluded_from_frontier: bottom-flux magnitude because the frozen bottom boundary is prescribed zero flux
runoff/ponding because D16 requires complete absorption of prescribed infiltration

comparison_metrics.R2_mapping_to_R16: repeat each 80-cm R2 cell-average theta across the corresponding eight 10-cm R16 cells before profile RMSE

positive_rule: internal preflight passes before SWAP trajectory generation
all S10/S25/S50/S75 R16, R2 and FMC histories complete with integrity
FMC all-step upper-storage RMSE <= R2 all-step upper-storage RMSE
FMC all-step mapped 16-cell theta RMSE <= R2
FMC hiatus-only upper-storage RMSE <= R2 hiatus-only upper-storage RMSE
FMC hiatus-only mapped 16-cell theta RMSE <= R2
decision_logic.lower_storage_note: Because total water input and zero bottom flux are matched, upper- and lower-storage errors are complementary; lower storage is reported but not duplicated as an independent gate.

successor_logic.if_positive: Retain FMC surface and groundwater branches for a later combined-boundary development experiment; still no ET/root uptake or production authority.
successor_logic.if_negative: Close the current surface falling-slug route without retuning D12-D15 discretization or D16 pulse design; reassess whether FMC remains groundwater-branch-only.
successor_logic.formal_performance: Deferred until a candidate spans enough hydrological branches to justify same-runtime timing.
